activity.notes: Gregor MacGregor captured Fernandina on Amelia Island on 29 June 1817 and proclaimed the short-lived Republic of the Floridas under a government headed by himself. He relinquished command and boarded ship on 4 September 1817. ATLAS models only his de facto Amelia Island regime, not all of Spanish Florida.

sources.title: Florida Historical Society — McGregor to Capture Spanish Florida
sources.citation_text: The Florida Historical Society records MacGregor's June 1817 capture of Amelia Island and establishment of a new government there.

sources.title: What's in a Fraud? The Many Worlds of Gregor MacGregor, 1817–1824 — Enterprise & Society
sources.citation_text: The scholarly article describes MacGregor's attempt to establish a Republic of the Floridas on Amelia Island in 1817 and his abandonment of the island within three months.
